globalRules: Never exceed the level's simultaneous regular-enemy cap.
Projectile and VFX caps are separate from the regular-enemy cap.
Boss minions share the regular-enemy cap.
Offscreen spawns require a readable approach route and cannot appear on a safe landing.
Enemy activation is deterministic from level state, not frame-rate dependent.
Nightmare increases overlap and density but does not remove telegraphs.
